articles.title: 27 Years in the Making: Kerr Shatters El Guerrouj's Mile Record in London
articles.summary: Josh Kerr ran a 3:42.66 mile at the London Diamond League, breaking a 27-year-old world record by 0.47 seconds. The 28-year-old Briton was paced perfectly and surged in the final 200 meters before a roaring crowd of 60,000. He became the sixth British man to hold the mark.

articles.title: Beyond the Pitch: How Women Are Redefining World Cup Fandom
articles.summary: NPR reporter Jasmine Garsd discovered a vibrant subculture of women expressing soccer passion through elaborate nail art at the 2026 World Cup. She also encountered a coach who overcame gender barriers and now mentors a team of young Muslim players, revealing how the sport's soul thrives in local communities.

articles.title: Nice Guy or Ruthless Plotter? Inside Andy Burnham's Rise to PM
articles.summary: Andy Burnham, 56, becomes UK prime minister on Monday after ousting Keir Starmer. Insiders describe him as affable yet ruthless—a Cambridge graduate, Everton fan, and poetry lover who danced to New Order at his victory event. But doubts linger about whether his charm translates into effective leadership.
